in_hebrew.name: לינל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Lily, or 'Darkness' in Hebrew. The name Lynelle comes from the Hebrew name Leah, which means 'weak' or 'tired', with the addition of the Hebrew word for 'lily' (nelle).

in_greek.name: Λυνέλλη
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Lynelle has no direct translation in Greek, but it can be derived from the Greek name Λύνη (Lynē), which means 'lioness' or 'lynn'. The name Lynelle may also be derived from the Greek name Λυνδά (Lynthia), which means 'strong in spirit'. The name Lynelle can be seen as a combination of the Greek words λύνη (lynē) and νέλλη (nellē), meaning 'lioness flower'.

in_latin.name: Lynella
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Lynelle has no direct translation in Latin, but it can be derived from the Latin name Liliolum, which means 'lily of the valley'. The name Lynelle can also be seen as a combination of the Latin words lupus (wolf) and lilium (lily), meaning 'wolf lily'.
